meaning: Official surface mappings are approximate bidirectional barycentric samplers, not a bijection or semantic SKEL-to-MHR map.

cycle_test.procedure: Lift all 6890 SMPL vertices from the MHR rest surface with mhr2smpl; reconstruct all 18439 MHR vertices from that lifted SMPL surface with smpl2mhr; replay each candidate's fixed MHR face/barycentric binding on the reconstructed vertices and compare with its point on the original MHR rest mesh.

limitations: Cycle consistency can pass even when a semantic correspondence is wrong.
The direct DMD37 anchor composition generally spans three distinct MHR source triangles and still needs a declared one-time surface projection to become a single MHR face binding.
